content.text: À zou ɠundiɠii ná-baala ziʋoiti teʋe,
é lɔɔzei Sela teʋebai ʋɔ pelei,
ti ve Zuda masagi ya Siyɔn gizei ma.
Moaɓe anzanuiti ta loni ziɛ wolai Aalanɔn maaleʋesuʋɛ,
eɠɛ wɔniiti ti ʋelazu,
ti vazagai ti ma laɠagi ʋa.
Moaɓe nuiti ti ɠɛ ma:
«Tɛnɛgi wo ga giye, faa ɠila deve!
Foloi ɠa gaalɔna, ɗa-niinigi ʋɛɛ gi ma eɠɛ kpidii.
Gá-ɠɔɔʋelaiti dɔɔɠu, mina pela nui yaava!
Moaɓe ɠɔɔʋelaiti ti zeezeibu zɔlɔɔ è ʋɔ bɛ!
Ɠɛ ga ti-lɔɔɠuzu faa zuɠoloɠolo nui ʋa.»
Mazɔlɔɔ, wɔinzeɠemai ɠa ɓe yeeta,
toosu vai ɠa ɓesu,
zɔi é toomai ɠɛɛzu,
toɠa ɲɛɛlɛ, é ɠula zooi ʋa.
Masagi ta ɠa zei Davide ná-masadai unda.
Ná-masa kpɔkpɔgi ɠa ɓaana, é lɛbi,
mazɔlɔɔ toɠa masadai ɠɛ nuɓusɛiti unda ga nuɓɔɠɔlai ta wooɠɛɠiladai.
Toɠa ʋilɛ sɔle fai ʋolu,
suvilɛ telebodai ɠɛɛzu.
Gi Moaɓe ná-wasogi ma woo mɛnini,
wasogi dateʋegai,
ná-gaazumaanɛɛi ta ná-wasogi,
ná-ziiɠaawanai ta koozu ɠisiɛ wafuungiti.
Tama Moaɓe nuiti ta kpee loo
naama vaiti su Moaɓe yooi ti sɔlɔɔ su.
Ti pɛ ta zɔngɔ, ti kpalagi wo, ti laavɔ,
mazɔlɔɔ leezɛn vɔɔi ma ɓuungi é ɠɛni ɓɛtɛzu Kiil-Ɠalezɛte, naa la mɔ ɠɛa.
Ɠɛsɛɓon lɔɓɔiti ti vɔa,
zou ɠundiɠiiti ti Siɓima leezɛn ɓeleiti ma lɔkulugiti koloɠologa,
ti zuvieni Yazɛɛl,
ti zeeli teʋebai zu, ti vaza ná,
ma pɔnɔbaiti ti vaza poun Kpoloɗɛ Wanai ʋoluʋelei.
Naa ɠa é ba, nà wɔlɔzu Siɓima ná-leezɛn ɓelei ma
eɠɛʋelei Yazɛɛl wɔlɔzu ma la.
Nà wo yɛɓɛzu ga gàazuɗɛi, Ɠɛsɛɓon ta Eleyalé,
mazɔlɔɔ kɔɔɠɔ ɓeei zolooga wa-leezɛin ziɠa vai ma ta ma waa ɠula vai.
Koozunɛɛi ta undaanɛɛi ɠulaa gulu ɓelei ʋa,
leezɛn ɓelei zu, guye la mɔ loozu, koozunɛɛ la ná.
Leezɛin ziɠa nuiti ti la mɔ tatisu kɔɠɛi zu.
Gè koozunɛ ɓain gooiti kwɛteʋea.
Naa ɠa é ba, sàsu ɠa ɓalizu Moaɓe ná-faa zu eɠɛ kɔnigi,
zìi ɗa gala Kiil-Ɠelɛse ná-faa zu.
Moaɓe nuiti pɛtɛ, ti ɓɔɠɔ ɓɔlɔzu zalaɠa ɠula adaʋɛti,
ti ɗa li ta-ɠɔɔɠɔ gani pɛlɛi wu,
ti ʋa ta-ɠɔɔɠɔ ganigiti fali,
kɛlɛ ti la ani nɔpɛ sɔlɔɔsu.

content: Wooiti kana Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ti woni kaite Moaɓe ná-faa zu.
Za, Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI wooi ɠa é ga nii:

content.text: «Aisa kona saʋagɔ ga daaɓa nɔ kpein,
eɠɛʋelei botiɠɛ nui zala ɠonagi ɠaalusu da,
Moaɓe yooi ná-lɛbiyai ɠa ɠɛ ga ɓaaɠulamai.
Anɛɛ ni ná-nuɓusɛi mɔinʋɛ gola,
nii goi a yɛ ná, é la ɠɛa ga ani nɔpɛ, gaa nɔpɛ ge la ɠɛa ba.»
